name: Will converting my bathtub to a shower decrease my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Will converting my bathtub to a shower decrease my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a bathtub to a shower generally does not decrease home value, especially if it's the only bathroom with a tub. In many markets, particularly among older demographics or those prioritizing accessibility, a walk-in shower is seen as a desirable upgrade. However, if your home has no other bathtubs, some potential buyers with young children might prefer a tub. The impact on value largely depends on market trends, the quality of the conversion, and whether it aligns with the overall style and price point of your home. A well-executed, stylish shower conversion can often enhance appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Converting a bathtub to a shower usually does not decrease home value, especially if another tub remains. It can enhance appeal for many buyers, particularly for accessibility. Quality and market trends are key.
